allot.subject: Monitoring Agency Report
allot.text: Shakti Pumps (India) Limited has intimated about the the Monitoring Agency Report dated 07.11.2025 issued by India Ratings & Research Private Limited,  for the quarter ended September 30, 2025 in respect of utilization of fund raised through Qualified Institutions Placements ( QIPs ) held on 22.03.2024 and 05.07.2025.

allot.subject: Press Release
allot.text: Shakti Pumps (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 07, 2025, titled "Shakti Pumps (India) Limited Successfully closing of QIP and raised Rs 292.60 Crores".

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Shakti Pumps (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 3187365 securities pursuant to Qualified Institution Placement at its treasury committee meeting held on July 05, 2025

allot.subject: Qualified Institutional Placement
allot.text: Shakti Pumps (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Outcome of the treasury committee meeting for issue closure.

allot.subject: Qualified Institutional Placement
allot.text: Shakti Pumps (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about issue opening for qualified Institutional Placement

allot.subject: Monitoring Agency Report
allot.text: Monitoring Agency Report for the Quarter ended March 31, 2025   in relation to the Qualified Institutions Placement (QIP) of Equity Shares of Shakti Pumps (India) Limited ( the Company )

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Shakti Pumps (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding "Grant of Stock Options under Shakti Pumps (India) Limited Employee Stock Option Plan 2024".

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Shakti Pumps (India) Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors of the Company in its meeting held today at January 07, 2025 has approved the raising of funds of Rs. 400 crore by way of Qualified Institutions Placement(s).
